tested_scope.policy_text: accept only exact strings matching ^[0-9a-f]{64}$; no trimming or normalization

python_re_match_anchor.reason: In Python regex semantics, $ may match immediately before a final newline, so re.match accepts the 64-hex-plus-U+000A string.

python_re_fullmatch.reason: fullmatch requires the entire 65-code-point string to satisfy exactly 64 lowercase hex characters.

mechanism_assessment.observation: The precommitted trailing-U+000A rejection invariant fails if the written ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ rule is operationalized with Python re.match: the 65-character candidate is accepted because $ matches before a final newline. The same candidate is rejected by fullmatch.
mechanism_assessment.inference: A reconstruction identity gate that must be exact and normalization-free should not rely on a $ end anchor without pinning engine semantics. A full-string primitive or explicit length-plus-character-set predicate is required to make the fail-closed property portable for this exact boundary.
mechanism_assessment.unverified: Other regex engines and modes, trailing CR or CRLF, non-ASCII line separators, uppercase or 0x-prefixed digests, more than two records, multiple malformed digests, concurrent parent generations, crash/rollback durability, digest collisions, and interoperability constraints remain untested.
